input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-0b3qrzkx/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_k6tfu1dh; W=/opt/uvcache/git-<REDACTED_B64>mobile_sam.pt
python convert_masks.py $W /tmp/outA demo_rgb.png demo_metadata.csv 2>&1 | tail -1
python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
d=pd.read_csv('/tmp/outA/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
print(d.columns.tolist()==o.columns.tolist(), len(d)==len(o), (d.drop(columns=['xmin','ymin','xmax','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])==o.drop(columns=['xmin','ymin','xmax','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])).all().all())
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); h,w=img.shape[:2]; cnt=np.zeros((h,w),int); vis=img.copy()
for i,r in d.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
    m=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8); pts=np.stack([xs,ys],1); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1); cnt+=m
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m); 
    rect=len(set(xs))<=2 and len(set(ys))<=2
    assert xs.min()==r.xmin and ys.max()==r.ymax
    if n!=2 or rect or len(xs)<4: print('bad',i,n,rect,len(xs))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max(), 'pts', d.coords_x.str.count(',').describe()[['min','mean']].tolist())
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
cmp /tmp/outA/demo_metadata.csv /tmp/outB/out.csv && echo same
